name: FAQ · property buyers
description: Narrow centred card FAQ on a light grey background.

items.question: How much deposit do I need?
items.answer: Most lenders ask for 5 to 10 percent. We will help you find schemes that lower that figure.

items.question: What fees should I budget for?
items.answer: Allow for legal fees, a survey, stamp duty where it applies and moving costs, typically 2 to 3 percent of the price.

items.question: How long does a purchase take?
items.answer: From accepted offer to keys usually takes 8 to 12 weeks, depending on the chain.

items.question: Can you recommend a mortgage broker?
items.answer: Yes. We work with three independent brokers and there is no charge for an introduction.
